title: Rainfall-ponding-runoff boundary authority before FMC hydrological comparison
purpose: Qualify a matched rainfall-supply, ponding-head and linear-runoff surface-boundary authority before any FMC versus R16/R2 rainfall-threshold trajectory comparison.

predecessor_authority.D14: Published Ogden-2015 Eq.18 surface-front kinematics qualified for h_p=0; Eq.19 slug kinematics qualified.
predecessor_authority.D15: Finite-volume rainfall allocation, dry-bin activation, finite surface store, runoff bookkeeping, hiatus transition and merge accounting qualified.
predecessor_authority.D16: Surface redistribution fidelity retained against R2 under prescribed infiltration and qbot=0.
predecessor_authority.D20: Longer fixed-water-table FMC persistence retained, but rainfall/ponding/runoff explicitly remained unqualified.
predecessor_authority.SWAP_dynamic_top: Current canonical b110 dynamic-top provider supports surface-flux, ponded-head and ponded-head-linear-runoff regimes.
predecessor_authority.WU04A_boundary: Dynamic-top runtime is admitted through Black optional-state composition. D21 uses zero potential evaporation and does not compose with groundwater mode 5.

rationale: The rainfall ladder is fixed before any R16/R2 trajectory exposure and spans sub-Ksat through strongly super-Ksat supply.
ponding_max=Ksat*dt reuses the finite-store scale already qualified in D15 rather than inventing a new application parameter.

runoff_resistance=1e-3 day is the minimum active linear-runoff resistance admitted by the current dynamic-top provider and is used as a qualification stress boundary, not as an application calibration.

SWAP_provider_oracle.top_state: exact D16 I_DEEP top 10-cm finite-volume average mapped through B01 inverse retention

candidate_iteration.rule: For each rainfall factor start candidate ponding at zero, evaluate the provider, then feed result candidate_ponding_depth back only as candidate_ponding_depth while committed previous_ponding_depth remains zero.
candidate_iteration.purpose: Emulate the provider's solver-candidate surface-water closure without running a Richards trajectory.

regime_classes.FLUX_NO_PONDING: route=surface-flux and candidate ponding=0 and runoff=0
regime_classes.PONDED_NO_RUNOFF: route=ponded-head and candidate ponding>0 and runoff=0
regime_classes.ACTIVE_LINEAR_RUNOFF: route=ponded-head-linear-runoff and candidate ponding>ponding_max and runoff>0

selection_rule: select the lowest ladder factor classified FLUX_NO_PONDING
select the lowest ladder factor classified PONDED_NO_RUNOFF
select the lowest ladder factor classified ACTIVE_LINEAR_RUNOFF
SWAP_provider_oracle.preflight_requirement: All three classes must exist with strictly increasing selected rainfall factor.

FMC_boundary_primitives.newly_qualified_dimension: nonzero h_p only; no change to constitutive law, bins, process step or capillary relaxation
requirement_h_p: all 99 I_DEEP Eq.18 velocities finite and positive for all h_p cases
all one-step raw front depths remain inside 0..160 cm
finite-volume potential infiltration demand is nondecreasing with h_p
D14 conservative relaxation changes no finite-volume storage

linear_surface_reservoir.law: For a post-infiltration provisional surface water depth W, if W<=ponding_max then S_new=W and runoff=0; otherwise solve S_new = W - dt/RSRO*(S_new-ponding_max), so S_new=(W+dt/RSRO*ponding_max)/(1+dt/RSRO) and runoff=W-S_new.
requirements: active-runoff case has S_new>ponding_max and runoff>0

positive_rule: SWAP provider oracle identifies all three ordered regimes from the frozen factor ladder
all provider evaluations are finite and converge under the frozen candidate iteration
FMC matched linear surface-reservoir primitive passes
stage1_gate.if_positive: Persist the three selected rainfall factors and authorize a separately locked Stage-2 coupled boundary micro-preflight before any R16/R2 rainfall-threshold trajectories.
stage1_gate.if_negative: Close D21 before trajectory comparison. Do not change ladder, ponding_max, runoff resistance, Eq.18, bins or timestep.

future_stage2_boundary.note: Stage 2, if authorized, must couple FMC infiltration demand, surface store and runoff using the Stage-1 selected rainfall factors. R16/R2 trajectory generation remains prohibited until that coupled micro-preflight passes.
